description: Screenshot of a Windows application titled 'Pepe Island Test' — a retro pixel-art point-and-click adventure game in the style of classic LucasArts titles. A Pepe the Frog character in a red shirt stands on a grassy island path near a small hole and a wooden signpost reading 'TENNIS', with hills, palm trees, a road and the sea behind. A verb menu bar (WALK, LOOK, INTERACT, TALK, INVENTORY) runs across the top, and the location name 'Rabbit Hole' is displayed at upper right.
text: Pepe Island Test. WALK. LOOK. INTERACT. TALK. INVENTORY. Rabbit Hole. TENNIS.
flags: Pepe the Frog imagery: originally a benign cartoon, also used as a meme symbol in some extremist contexts; here it appears as a game character

description: Pixel-art scene, apparently from the same 'Pepe Island' fan-made adventure game, showing a Pepe the Frog character in a red shirt standing beside palm trees before a blue-and-white striped temple with a gold dome and gold bird/owl statues at its corners. The building closely resembles the widely photographed temple structure on Little St. James Island (Jeffrey Epstein's island), rendered here as a game backdrop with a stone path, geometric key-pattern walls and ocean behind.
flags: Building is a stylized game rendering resembling the Little St. James temple, not a photograph
Pepe the Frog imagery: benign cartoon origin, also used as a meme symbol in some extremist contexts

description: Blurry photograph, widely circulated in 2019, showing former President Bill Clinton standing with his arm around Ghislaine Maxwell in the open doorway at the top of a private jet's airstair. Reporting has identified the aircraft as Jeffrey Epstein's private jet; the aircraft itself carries no visible identifying markings in the frame. Clinton wears dark clothing and Maxwell a light sweater; ocean or sky fills the background.
flags: Identification of the jet as Epstein's comes from media reporting, not from anything visible in the image
Image is low resolution/blurry; identifications based on the widely published version of this photo

Text at top and edges is cropped by the photo framing.

description: Dark-mode screenshot from a Q-drop aggregator showing Q post #2791, dated 18 Feb 2019, posted under tripcode !!mG7VJxZNCI. The drop quotes an anonymous post claiming Director of National Intelligence Dan Coats would soon be forced out, sourcing the claim to Trump friend and Newsmax CEO Chris Ruddy, and Q replies 'Interesting this leaked already.' The claim is the drop's, presented without verification.
